blog_rows.label: gxhash-64 v3.5.0
blog_rows.note: 15 versus 16 bytes. Equal-length 24-byte witness gives 1.585 bits; both verified.

blog_rows.label: MuseAir v0.3
blog_rows.note: SMHasher3 version only. Supplied upstream audit records algorithm v2 / crate 0.6.0 and deprecated earlier versions.

blog_rows.label: komihash v5.27 / v5.34
blog_rows.note: This high-probability construction applies to lengths 64..127 bytes only; not an all-length probability.

blog_rows.label: SpookyHash V2-64
blog_rows.note: 0.5001 rounds the second-family measurement 0.500068247318268. Exact balance over the seed space is unproved; full 128-bit outputs also collide.

blog_rows.label: aHash 0.8.12, AES path
blog_rows.note: Score uses verifier pool 2616/2^31 in heur_panel synthesis. Original 1227/2^30 and second family 75/2^26 are compatible sampling estimates.

blog_rows.label: t1ha2_atonce-64 v2.1.4
blog_rows.note: Cross-length 16/11-byte pair. Exact class density 2^-26 multiplied by measured conditional rate about 2^-4. Equal-length best claim not independently re-run; excluded.

blog_rows.label: a5hash v5.21, 64-bit
blog_rows.note: Exact sufficient seed class, not equality for total epsilon. Best verified score upper bound, not an exhaustive minimum over lengths. v5.25 not vector-checked.

blog_rows.label: a5hash v5.21, 128-bit
blog_rows.note: Additional variant, not one of the original ten entries.

blog_rows.label: HighwayHash-64, frozen
blog_rows.note: Conservative 96-byte headline witness. Exact sufficient-event contribution, not exact total collision probability. All 64/128/256 output widths inherit it. Original second-family capped sample confirmed pair but not exact numerator.

blog_rows.label: Horner / unrolled, GF(2^64)
blog_rows.note: Unrolled M2: 5.1 / 7.4 GB/s. Score uses the output-width floor.

blog_rows.label: Injective recurrence, eight lanes
blog_rows.note: Bound formula comes from harness comment transcribed in provable.json, not a separately supplied proof file.

blog_rows.label: PolymurHash 2.0
blog_rows.note: Conservative global score with n≤8L retains +14. Paper reports 57 (README approximation gives 57.2); plotted score ≈53.5 is derived from the unsimplified bound. Seed-to-k distribution is an additional assumption.

blog_rows.label: UMASH-64
blog_rows.note: Per-call seed carries no guarantee. Proof sketch, not machine verification. SMHasher3 reports FAIL 123/250; reseed variant FAIL 214/250.

blog_rows.label: UMASH-128 fingerprint
blog_rows.note: Paper prints 83. A quadratic length bound does not imply 83 for an unbounded-length minimum. Excluded from shared-domain figure.

blog_rows.label: CLHASH
blog_rows.note: For >1024 B the extra L normalization makes the conservative score ≥64. Reference pseudorandom expansion is not the theorem’s key distribution. Statistical FAIL 64/250; not a claim about ideal-key collision bound.

blog_rows.label: ChainHash, 1 KB blocks
blog_rows.note: Timed 64-bit SplitMix64 seed family outside proof. No same-host published result.

blog_rows.label: ChainHash, 256 B blocks
blog_rows.note: Paper rounds score down to 62. Timed seed expansion outside proof. No same-host published result.

blog_rows.label: Carryless NH (CLNH)
blog_rows.note: Score 64 is conservative; this is not the full CLHASH implementation.

blog_rows.label: NH with 64-bit words
blog_rows.note: Conservative score ≥64; minimum message L=2 would allow the sharper ≥65. No CLNH speed assigned to integer NH.

blog_rows.label: Vector multiply-shift
blog_rows.note: Paper’s L+1 counts 128-bit keys despite caption; corrected to 64-bit words. SMHasher3’s wrapped 256-word implementation has bulk speed 1.79 but that is not a speed for this full independent-key family; excluded.

blog_rows.label: Simple tabulation
blog_rows.note: SMHasher3 tabulation-64 at 3.12 B/cycle is a composite string hash, not this theorem’s direct family; excluded. Three-wise independence implies the pair bound.

aliases.mx3: all three registered revisions; no unversioned registration

method.bulk: Average across alignments 7..0 for fixed 262144-byte keys; higher bytes/cycle wins, with higher reported GiB/sec breaking rounded ties; GiB/sec from that same run
method.small: Average for lengths 1..31; lower cycles/hash wins, independently of bulk
method.additional_bulk: [262017,262144]-byte section retained in each run but not used for headline figures
method.throughput_warning: Reported GiB/sec is calculated with a fixed 3.5 GHz assumption, not measured wall-clock throughput.
method.M2_gate: Before starting the two passes: poll every 60 seconds for 1-minute load < 3.0, with a 10800-second (3-hour) deadline. Run and flag timeout if the threshold is never met.

archived_M2_oldbinary.reason: Supplied build-advtest binary used older degree-7 ChainHash finalizer. All M2 rows rerun using current-source build-speed binary.
